sources.title: 琳琅閣書店 catalogue item 69: 野獲編三十巻補遺四巻, 24冊
sources.quality_notes: First-party seller PDF search index and a matching Japan antiquarian-marketplace listing describe one 24-book offer with 1827 Fuli Shanfang and 1869 revised-print references. Original PDF was too large for direct web visual inspection; image/page/leaf identity and exact impression remain unverified. The two displays are one seller offer, not two independently witnessed ancient copies.
